title: While ZOH listens for an answer, an unrelated question isn't taken as one
origin: Issue #169 (answers to founders' questions come back as alerts)

history.text: [voice: chapter 6 done, the desert scenes are so good]
Chapter 6 in the bag, Maya 📚 Same time tomorrow, chapter 7.
Morning Maya! Curious, what's made mornings the hardest part this week?
Go get it, Maya! Chapter 7 at 9 when you're home 📚

plan.reason: A chapter a night keeps the story moving without eating your evening.

step_days.proof_seen: voice recap of the desert scenes

team.body: Ask what's made mornings hardest for her this week

testerLines: wait what chapter am I on tonight?
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a text that isn't about the question must not be recorded as the answer.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH tells her tonight is chapter 7 at 9. It does not record her text as an answer to the mornings question and does not ask the mornings question again.
